subject: MAP: SOC 2 traceability, SIG mapping, and retention carveouts — accelerated close plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <ogrant@cleardata.com>, Marta Ruiz <mruiz@cleardata.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP packet + traceability matrix for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Hi Oliver and Marta,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I attached an updated MAP packet that ties the SOC 2 controls we’ve already documented to the SIG/CAIQ checklist and the specific DPA clauses you flagged in the RFI. The goal here is to make the acceptance path explicit so your procurement and security teams can sign off faster.

Highlights in this packet:
- A traceability sheet mapping SOC 2 control IDs -> SIG question -> Redlined DPA clause
- Proposed retention carveouts for test data and metrics (to address your regulatory needs)
- A short, 2-week accelerated evidence intake schedule if you decide to proceed this cycle

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)], [Attachment: SOC2_summary_Q3.pdf (PDF, 345KB)]

Can you confirm whether the retention carveout suggestion (sheet "Retention-Options") fits your legal constraints? If so we’ll produce the DPA redline for final circulation.

If helpful I can loop in Kimberly to walk through the traceability matrix in a 30-minute session. Proposed times attached in the sheet.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

From: Oliver Grant <ogrant@cleardata.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@cleardata.com>, security@cleardata.com, legal@cleardata.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP packet + traceability matrix for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Rafael,

Thanks for sending — appreciate the clear mapping. Quick notes from our side after a read-through:

- The SOC 2 -> SIG mapping is helpful, but we need explicit evidence owners for the items under CC3 (change control) and CC6 (access revocation). Can you add who at Redwood will provide each artifact?
- The retention carveouts look reasonable in principle. Legal wants to see a short memo on how logs with PII are purged in the 30/90-day buckets.
- For DPA: we cannot accept a blanket EU residency carveout. We need a version that keeps EU customer data within EU regions.

Also our legal would like to see the DPA redline; can you send a tracked version? If you can get that to us by EOD Wednesday, we'll try to get an internal sign-off by next Thursday.

Oliver
Director, Information Security | ClearData
ogrant@cleardata.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP packet + traceability matrix for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Kimberly / Naomi — forwarding Oliver's notes. Quick internal plan:

1) Kimberly: can you add evidence owners in the traceability sheet for CC3 and CC6? Put the owner email in column E and a one-line description of the artifact.
2) Naomi: can you draft a two-paragraph memo that explains our log purge windows (30/90 days) and how PII is scoped/hashed for metrics? Legal will need that inline with the DPA redline.
3) I'll prepare a tracked DPA redline that enforces EU residency for EU-labeled customers and proposes a limited retention carveout for non-production telemetry.

Timeline: we want to hit Oliver's EOD Wednesday ask for the DPA redline. That gives their legal enough runway for Thursday internal sign-off. If we miss that, the close window slides 1–2 weeks.

Also, thinking about an "escape hatch" if they push for a faster sign: propose a temporary SLA credit + 30-day escrow for logs while we finish region-locked data export tooling. Worth discussing?

Thanks — Rafael

Oliver / Marta — attaching the tracked DPA redline and the updated MAP sheet with evidence owners filled in. Highlights:

- Evidence owners: Kimberly added owner emails for CC3/CC6 and included a small example artifact path for each.
- EU residency: DPA redline enforces region restriction for "EU-labeled customer data" and adds a clause for customer-driven export requests.
- Retention memo: Naomi attached a short memo describing the 30/90-day window, scoping (production vs. telemetry), and PII minimization steps.

Attachments: [Attachment: DPA_redlines_Cleardata.docx (DOCX, 45KB)], [Attachment: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 215KB)], [Attachment: SOC2_summary_Q3.pdf (PDF, 345KB)]

What I'm asking from you: please confirm that the EU residency clause is acceptable and whether the retention memo covers legal's concern. If both look good, we can circulate the finalized DPA for signature (DocuSign link included below).

DocuSign (for reference): https://app.docusign.com/containers/12345-RWI-3287
